question:
Study the table showing the literacy rate of males and females in six states and answer the question.

State | Male Literacy Rate (%) | Female Literacy Rate (%)
State A | 85 | 75
State B | 90 | 88
State C | 78 | 65
State D | 92 | 85
State E | 80 | 70
State F | 88 | 80

Q. Consider the following statements based on the literacy rate table:
I. State B has the highest combined (average of male and female) literacy rate among all six states.
II. The difference between male literacy and female literacy is highest in State C.
III. The average female literacy rate across all six states is exactly 77.17%.
Which of the above statements are correct?
explanation: State B average = (90+88)/2 = 89% (highest). Differences: A=10, B=2, C=13, D=7, E=10, F=8; State C has the highest difference of 13, so Statement II is correct. Female total = 75+88+65+85+70+80 = 463; average = 463 / 6 = 77.166...% or 77.17%, so Statement III is correct. Thus, all three statements are correct.
question_hi:
छह राज्यों में पुरुषों और महिलाओं की साक्षरता दर को दर्शाने वाली तालिका का अध्ययन करें और प्रश्न का उत्तर दें।

राज्य | पुरुष साक्षरता दर (%) | महिला साक्षरता दर (%)
राज्य A | 85 | 75
राज्य B | 90 | 88
राज्य C | 78 | 65
राज्य D | 92 | 85
राज्य E | 80 | 70
राज्य F | 88 | 80

प्र. साक्षरता दर तालिका के आधार पर निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
I. सभी छह राज्यों में राज्य B की संयुक्त (पुरुष और महिला का औसत) साक्षरता दर सबसे अधिक है।
II. राज्य C में पुरुष साक्षरता और महिला साक्षरता के बीच का अंतर सबसे अधिक है।
III. सभी छह राज्यों में औसत महिला साक्षरता दर ठीक 77.17% है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा कथन सही है?
explanation_hi: राज्य B का औसत = 89% (सबसे अधिक)। अंतर: A=10, B=2, C=13, D=7, E=10, F=8; राज्य C में सबसे अधिक अंतर 13 है, अतः कथन II सही है। महिला कुल = 463; औसत = 463 / 6 = 77.17%, अतः कथन III सही है। इस प्रकार, तीनों कथन सही हैं।

Q. Consider the following statements:
I. The overall average percentage of marks obtained by Divya across all five subjects is 91.8%.
II. Mathematics has the highest average score among all five subjects.
III. Esha secured the lowest total marks across all five subjects.

Which of the above statements are correct?
explanation: Divya's total = 92+90+98+85+94 = 459, average = 459/5 = 91.8%. Mathematics averages: (90+85+95+98+70+80)/5 = 518/5 = 103.6 sum / 6 = 86.33 (highest). Esha's total = 55+60+70+65+68 = 318, which is the lowest among all students. All statements are correct, making option B the right answer.

question:
Study the following table showing the number of research papers published by five institutions (P, Q, R, S, T) over four years, and answer the question given below.

Institution | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
P | 45 | 60 | 75 | 90
Q | 30 | 45 | 60 | 75
R | 60 | 80 | 100 | 120
S | 25 | 35 | 50 | 70
T | 50 | 55 | 65 | 80

Consider the following statements regarding the research output:
I. The overall percentage increase in total papers published by all five institutions from 2020 to 2023 is exactly 85.5%.
II. Institution R accounts for more than 28% of the total research papers published across all institutions and all four years combined.
III. The average number of papers published per year by Institution S across the four years is 45.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
explanation: Total papers in 2020 = 210, in 2023 = 395, percentage increase = (185/210)*100 = 88.09% (Statement I is incorrect). Total papers for R = 360; grand total across all = 1285; 360/1285 = 28.01% (Statement II is correct). Average for S = (25+35+50+70)/4 = 180/4 = 45 (Statement III is correct). Thus, only statements II and III are correct.
question_hi:

संस्थान | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
P | 45 | 60 | 75 | 90
Q | 30 | 45 | 60 | 75
R | 60 | 80 | 100 | 120
S | 25 | 35 | 50 | 70
T | 50 | 55 | 65 | 80

शोध आउटपुट के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. 2020 से 2023 तक सभी पांच संस्थानों द्वारा प्रकाशित कुल पत्रों में समग्र प्रतिशत वृद्धि ठीक 85.5% है।
II. संस्थान R सभी संस्थानों और सभी चार वर्षों में कुल प्रकाशित शोध पत्रों का 28% से अधिक हिस्सा रखता है।
III. चार वर्षों में संस्थान S द्वारा प्रति वर्ष प्रकाशित पत्रों की औसत संख्या 45 है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
